proofs.text: Verify `_update_pending` is true for the v0.9.5 fixture and false once the update has run; verify `sync_status` on the 0.10 fixture contains `Run: purlin:init --update`, that it still does after the run once `.purlin/records/README.md` is deleted, and that it does not once nothing is pending

reasons: PROOF-19 implementation_coupling: Names a private symbol, a selector or a path instead of an observable outcome, so a refactor breaks the proof without changing behaviour.
PROOF-19 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: `sync_status` prints the directive to run the update while anything is pending, including when the config alone is already clean, and stops printing it once nothing is

tests.name: test_pending_is_false_once_the_update_has_run
